text:
🚨 Breaking News: The Surveillance Law – which would authorize PIBA to spy on couples, demand access to phones and computers, and interrogate anyone about the couple, including neighbors and employers – has officially been placed on the parliamentary agenda.

The bill is expected to be brought forward soon for its first reading and vote in parliament. If approved, it will move to the Interior Committee as the legislative process advances.

More updates will follow.

Read more on our website, link in the first comment.
